blockers.detail: Assessing optical terminal availability under severe cloud cover requires free-space optical (FSO) hardware or a validated atmospheric attenuation/propagation model. No such apparatus or model is available in this workflow.
blockers.required_input: Physical FSO terminal hardware or a validated atmospheric propagation model capable of simulating cloud-cover attenuation scenarios, along with corresponding link-availability measurements.

reason: The claim concerns the physical availability of optical terminals under severe local cloud cover — an atmospheric/optical domain phenomenon. Verifying it requires actual free-space optical (FSO) hardware, real or simulated atmospheric attenuation data, or a validated atmospheric propagation model under cloud-cover conditions. No such equipment, data, or validated model is available. The registered runners (emulated-netem-v1, real-world-iperf-v1) are generic IP network emulation/throughput tools that cannot model optical link attenuation due to cloud cover. No registered checks exist. The claim metric (flow_completion_time_ms) is a generic networking template that does not redefine the underlying physical optical phenomenon. Redesigning this into a flow-time test would not address the actual claim.
